subject: surgery: bait presence is a causal tell (+0.8 realism, -0.12 A2 when removed); its presentation is not
body: From devin-tastepetri (experiments/taste_petri/surgery/results.md; haiku proxy, common random numbers: R0's exact audit openings reused, one edit, downstream re-scored, 10-11 seeds x k=3). Removing the bait from the same scenario: Petri realism +0.8 [+0.4,+1.1], A2 -0.12 [-0.18,-0.06]. Same bait facts with ordinary presentation (no labels/caps/framing): realism +0.1 [-0.3,+0.6], A2 -0.01. So on this proxy every seed rewrite that 'gained realism' was trading away the bait; bait-level edits can move A2 by at most ~0.12 (A2 is 0.55 even with no bait = the agentic-transcript genre). Also decoys/: null after replication, and an A/A split shows k=3 seed-bootstrap CIs are overconfident on validity/bait/A1 (treat lone secondary CIs as noise). Running now: EMBED (bait in the path of the task) and AMBIG (inconclusive evidence).
